name: Murasaki Reona
source:
[b]The companioning prince character.[/b]

A princely half trap.
Since he does not crossdress like the other students, just like Iori, he is considered an anomalous presence at Ayanohara academy.
However, his aristocratic status allows him to occupy a unique prince-like role among students and is well liked by them.
He's a good friend that helps Iori in various ways out of concern for him.

[From [url=https://no-strike.jp/yuribatake/character-en/]Official Website[/url]]
